results.rationale: Currencyservice displays the strongest near-onset internal mechanism evidence (CPU drop, memory spike, socket spike) among all components, indicating resource exhaustion. Its degradation can explain the observed symptoms: it is called by frontend and checkoutservice, and the timing (onset 1732370183, before frontend errors at 1732370187) supports causality. Alternative hypotheses fail: redis lacks trace dependency evidence and has a small, isolated memory decrease; frontend and checkoutservice are downstream symptom aggregators; productcatalogservice’s dominant latency is too late. Despite a minor pre-existing checkoutservice latency spike, the currencyservice anomaly is the primary driver of the incident.
